summary: Generic mapping, data-value/checked bindings, literal handler arguments, configured backend identity, and direct role binding are supported by source and focused tests. Amend for admission of an unobserved missing-target GoSlice shape and cross-lane runtime incompatibilities: action casing and stale-tick snapshots after renderer unmount. Browser E2E remains unverified.

probes.probe: lowerView with GoSlice Node.Kids wrapper omitting target
lowerView event callback wired directly to current mountCompiledApp runtime dispatch
probes.result: failure stage dispatch-input; message Action must contain exactly event, path, value; trace remained at init tick

limits: No generated app or browser mount was exercised; N6 remains the browser conformance gate.
React focus capture/restore is implemented, but the checked-in tests cover lower-level keyed identity rather than physical focus/selection restoration in a DOM.
